name: Should I manage a fourplex myself or hire a property manager?

mainEntity.name: Should I manage a fourplex myself or hire a property manager?

acceptedAnswer.text: The decision to self-manage or hire a property manager depends on your time availability, experience, and comfort level with landlord responsibilities. Self-management saves costs but requires significant time for tenant screening, rent collection, and maintenance. A professional property manager, often essential for busy investors or those out of the area, handles these tasks for a fee, which can be particularly beneficial for properties across diverse locations like Miami-Dade and Orange County.
acceptedAnswer.description: Self-managing saves money but demands time; a property manager handles tasks for a fee. Your choice depends on time and experience.
